'Has first given the appropriate turn signal': sig.turn_indicator, 'the turn indicator state in {off, left, right}', showing left, or sig.hand_signal, 'a driver's or rider's arm signal; meaning in {..., left, ...}', meaning left, at the last observation before the crossing began (the crossing having held at every observation since). The indicator's 'Not a stand-in for: the turn or lane change itself' does not apply: the signal is read, not the manoeuvre."}, {"span": "s10", "atoms": ["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle", "prim.region_lateral_offset", "st.centre_line", "kin.extent", "st.intersection", "st.driveway_or_alley_entrance"], "derived": [], "justification": "The same crossing as s6 (prim.region_lateral_offset of the centre line against half the kin.extent width) by the vehicle. The region at which the left-hand turn of s11 is declared is the place a left turn leaves the highway for: st.intersection ('the region where two roadways meet') or st.driveway_or_alley_entrance ('private road, alley or driveway meeting the highway'); the declared intention takes one of them as its target."}, {"span": "s8b", "atoms": ["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic", "rel.oncoming", "rel.same_direction", "rel.bearing"], "derived": [], "justification": "'Traffic' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic, 'pedestrians, ridden or herded animals, vehicles and other conveyances either singly or together using any highway for purposes of travel'; ru.aggregate is 'true when the user carries an included class'. Oncoming: rel.oncoming, 'headings opposed and closing', with tolerance p.oncoming_heading_cos; its exclusion (not the direction a road user approaches an intersection from) does not apply, as the words concern road users meeting the subject head-on on this highway. Following: a member behind the subject, 'direction of b from a in a's frame (for ... immediately to the rear)' (rel.bearing, negative longitudinal component), with 'headings aligned' (rel.same_direction, tolerance p.contest_same_direction_cos)."}, {"span": "s15b", "atoms": ["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic", "rel.oncoming", "rel.same_direction", "rel.bearing"], "derived": [], "justification": "As s8b: members of the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic that are oncoming (rel.oncoming, 'headings opposed and closing') or following (behind by rel.bearing, 'immediately to the rear', with rel.same_direction, 'headings aligned')."}, {"span": "s12", "atoms": ["sig.turn_indicator", "sig.hand_signal"], "derived": [], "justification": "The appropriate signal for a crossing to the left to make a left-hand turn is sig.turn_indicator state left or sig.hand_signal meaning left ('a driver's or rider's arm signal'), given at the last observation before the crossing began; its manner and distance are the compliance with NRS 484B.413 composed on s13. Not the turn itself (indicator's exclusion)."}], "operationalizations": [{"span": "s8", "standard": "no impediment to oncoming or following traffic", "concepts": ["prim.closest_approach_within", "prim.closest_approach_distance"], "params": ["p.conflict_horizon", "p.conflict_centre_clearance"], "convention": "traffic-conflict technique: a road user of traffic is impeded where its centre and the subject's, under constant velocities, approach within the conflict horizon to a centre distance below the conflict clearance; oncoming is rel.oncoming within the opposed-heading tolerance, following is a road user behind the subject (negative longitudinal bearing) with headings aligned within the same-direction tolerance; read at every observation of the crossing", "surrogate": false}, {"span": "s14", "standard": "it is safe", "concepts": ["prim.closest_approach_within", "prim.closest_approach_distance", "rel.contact"], "params": ["p.conflict_horizon", "p.conflict_centre_clearance"], "convention": "traffic-conflict technique: the crossing is safe where no road user of the scene is in contact with the subject and none approaches the subject's centre, under constant velocities, within the conflict horizon to a centre distance below the conflict clearance; read at every observation of the crossing", "surrogate": false}, {"span": "s15", "standard": "no impediment to oncoming or following traffic", "concepts": ["prim.closest_approach_within", "prim.closest_approach_distance"], "params": ["p.conflict_horizon", "p.conflict_centre_clearance"], "convention": "as for s8: traffic-conflict technique on oncoming (rel.oncoming) and following (behind, headings aligned) members of traffic, read at every observation of the crossing", "surrogate": false}], "assumptions": [], "intentions": [{"span": "s11", "id": "int.left_turn"}], "compositions": [{"span": "s13", "rule": "NRS_484B_413_2", "map": {"subject": "subject"}, "as": "compliance"}], "residues": [{"span": "s9", "why": "'Except where otherwise provided' defers to provisions it does not name; those provisions are judged by their own rules, and this rule's verdict on crossing the striping to make a left-hand turn is the same whether or not they apply.", "scope": "none"}], "binders": [{"name": "subject", "class_elements": ["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"]}], "applicability": "The subject, a vehicle, occupies a highway h on which a centre line c lies, and is within a no-passing zone: it occupies a travel region that a dev.zone_sign of kind no_passing (end false) governs, or it occupies a lane whose left-side st.lane_marking is solid or double_solid and yellow (where that marking is solid_broken, membership is unknown).", "obligation": "At every such observation the subject's body does not reach past the centre line c to its left: the lateral offset of c from the subject (prim.region_lateral_offset, left positive) is not below half the subject's width (kin.extent) minus p.lateral_position_tolerance. A crossing is excused (E3) where, within p.vehicle_turn_window ahead, the subject occupies a highway other than h and no longer occupies h; at the last observation before the crossing began (the crossing having held at every observation since) its turn indicator showed left or its hand signal meant left; and at every observation of the crossing no member of traffic (ru.aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic) that is oncoming (rel.oncoming, p.oncoming_heading_cos) or following (behind by rel.bearing, rel.same_direction within p.contest_same_direction_cos) has a closest approach to the subject within p.conflict_horizon at a centre distance below p.conflict_centre_clearance. A crossing is also excused (E4) where the subject's declared intention int.left_turn at an intersection or a driveway/alley entrance holds at the observation; the left signal was given as in E3; NRS_484B_413_2 is complied with for the subject; no road user is in contact with the subject or has such a closest approach (safe); and no oncoming or following member of traffic has such a closest approach (impediment).", "params": ["p.lateral_position_tolerance", "p.vehicle_turn_window", "p.conflict_horizon", "p.conflict_centre_clearance", "p.oncoming_heading_cos", "p.contest_same_direction_cos"], "narrowings": [{"span": "s2", "why": "'a driver' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion: the duty binds the vehicle's conduct whoever or whatever controls it", "kind": "observable_reading", "category": "agency"}, {"span": "s3", "why": "The striping designed to mark the zone is read where it lies along the centre line dividing the two directions; a no-passing marking between two lanes of the same direction is not read as the zone's striping.", "kind": "reading"}, {"span": "s7", "why": "'to an adjoining highway' is read through the conduct it explains: the subject reaching another highway within the turn window after the crossing", "kind": "observable_reading", "category": "purpose"}, {"span": "s8", "why": "'impediment' is read only through closest-approach conflicts with oncoming or following road users of traffic; a slowing of traffic without such a conflict is not read", "kind": "reading"}, {"span": "s15", "why": "'impediment' is read only through closest-approach conflicts with oncoming or following road users of traffic", "kind": "reading"}], "scenarios": [{"name": "forbid", "expected": "violated", "narrative": "The subject vehicle occupies a lane whose left st.lane_marking is solid yellow; it moves left until prim.region_lateral_offset of the centre line is -1.0 m to overtake a slower vehicle; int.left_turn is declared false at every region and it stays on the same highway."}, {"name": "permit", "expected": "compliant", "narrative": "The subject occupies the same no-passing lane (left marking solid yellow) and keeps the centre line 0.9 m to its left with a body width of 1.8 m plus margin: the offset stays above half its width minus the tolerance."}, {"name": "idle", "expected": "not_applicable", "narrative": "The subject's lane has a broken white left marking and no no_passing dev.zone_sign governs any region it occupies; it crosses the centre line to overtake."}, {"name": "blind", "expected": "unknown", "narrative": "The source does not observe st.lane_marking and no zone sign is in the scene; the subject's body reaches past the centre line.", "masked": ["st.lane_marking"]}, {"name": "branch_1", "expected": "compliant", "narrative": "In the no-passing zone the subject's int.left_turn is declared true at a driveway_or_alley_entrance; its left indicator has been on for the last 120 m and NRS_484B_413_2 is complied with; it crosses the centre line; no other road user is in the scene."}, {"name": "branch_2", "expected": "violated", "narrative": "As branch_1 but sig.turn_indicator is off and sig.hand_signal no_signal at the observation before the crossing."}, {"name": "branch_3", "expected": "violated", "narrative": "As branch_1 but an oncoming vehicle (rel.oncoming) has a closest approach to the subject in 2 s at a centre distance of 1 m."}, {"name": "branch_4", "expected": "violated", "narrative": "As branch_1 but the left indicator came on only 10 m before the crossing, so NRS_484B_413_2 is violated although a signal was given at the observation before the crossing."}, {"name": "branch_5", "expected": "compliant", "narrative": "In the zone the subject signals left, crosses the centre line and within the turn window occupies another highway and no longer the zone's highway; no oncoming or following road user has a conflicting closest approach."}], "literals": [], "param_proposals": [{"name": "p.lateral_position_tolerance", "unit": "m", "value": 0.3, "convention": "the lateral margin within which a vehicle body counts as at a line or an edge: lane-keeping variability of a driven vehicle plus the source's position error", "source": "naturalistic lane-keeping studies; source position error"}, {"name": "p.vehicle_turn_window", "unit": "s", "value": 10.0, "convention": "the longest duration of a turn by a motor vehicle at a junction or into or out of a driveway, from the start of its heading change to its end, including the crossing of opposing lanes", "source": "AASHTO Green Book intersection sight distance (left-turn time gap 7.5 s) plus a margin"}, {"name": "p.conflict_horizon", "unit": "s", "value": 3.0, "convention": "time-to-collision threshold of the traffic-conflict technique: a closest approach later than this is not a present danger of a crash", "source": "traffic conflict technique literature (Hyden 1987)"}, {"name": "p.conflict_centre_clearance", "unit": "m", "value": 3.0, "convention": "centre-to-centre distance at the closest approach below which the bodies of a passenger car and another road user are taken to collide or nearly collide: about a car's half-length plus half a body width", "source": "AASHTO passenger-car design vehicle dimensions"}, {"name": "p.oncoming_heading_cos", "unit": "ratio", "value": 0.9, "convention": "cosine of the largest angle off exactly opposed headings (about 25 degrees) at which two vehicles count as proceeding in opposite directions", "source": "geometric convention"}, {"name": "p.contest_same_direction_cos", "unit": "ratio", "value": 0.95, "convention": "cosine of the largest heading difference (about 18 degrees) for travel in the same direction", "source": "geometric convention"}], "gaps": [], "gap_resolutions": []}

lines: {"node_id": "LVMC_11_52_030_B", "law_refs": ["LVMC-11-52-030-B"], "subject": {"binder": "subject", "class_elements": ["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"]}, "segmentation": [{"id": "s1", "text": "The parking of vehicles is prohibited or restricted in certain zones as set forth in this Section.", "role": "subject"}, {"id": "s2", "text": "The location of such zones shall be established by posting appropriate signage or other durable markings, by painting curbs or the edges of road surfaces in accordance with the colors listed below, or by a combination thereof:", "role": "condition"}, {"id": "s3", "text": "Yellow indicates a zone for:", "role": "obligation"}, {"id": "s4", "text": "(1) Commercial vehicles to stop, stand or park for the purpose of loading or unloading freight", "role": "exception"}, {"id": "s5", "text": "in accordance with the conditions and times posted on an accompanying sign; and", "role": "exception"}, {"id": "s6", "text": "(2) Taxicabs to stop, stand, park for the purpose of loading, unloading or waiting for passengers", "role": "exception"}, {"id": "s7", "text": "in accordance with the conditions and times posted on an accompanying sign.", "role": "exception"}], "elements": [{"span": "s1", "atoms": ["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"], "derived": [], "justification": "'vehicles' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle ('every device in, upon or by which any person or property is or may be transported or drawn upon a highway'), one atom, never expanded; 'is prohibited or restricted in certain zones' introduces the restriction the yellow zone states."}, {"span": "s2", "atoms": ["st.curb_zone", "rel.occupies"], "derived": [], "justification": "Same words, same atoms as LVMC_11_52_030_A: st.curb_zone 'a signed or marked length of curb; ... colour ... where the curb itself is painted', whose presence is the evidence that the zone was established (observable_reading status); rel.occupies ('a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region (... curb zone ...)') anchors the subject in it."}, {"span": "s3", "atoms": ["st.curb_zone", "rel.occupies"], "derived": ["drv.motion.complete_halt"], "justification": "'Yellow indicates a zone for' the uses listed: the subject occupies (rel.occupies) a st.curb_zone of colour yellow. Because the zone is for those uses only, any other halt in it (drv.motion.complete_halt, 'at rest at the observation') is restricted. 'stop' in the list has two posted definitions (DEF-NRS-484A-255, DEF-NRS-484A-260), each with its own scope. Both are a halting, and the halting is what the concept reads, so neither is chosen over the other."}, {"span": "s4", "atoms": ["ru.aggregate=DEF-LVMC-11-02-070::commercial_vehicle"], "derived": ["drv.motion.complete_halt"], "justification": "Nearest atoms only; the span carries gap (s4). 'Commercial vehicles' is the admitted aggregate DEF-LVMC-11-02-070::commercial_vehicle ('a motor vehicle or combination of motor vehicle and trailer maintained or used primarily for the furtherance of a commercial enterprise'), one atom, never replaced by ru.commercial_motor_vehicle or ru.truck, which the definition's words do not equate with it. The run's reading includes no class under it, so membership is never decided and the exception's leaf is vacuous, which the gap states. 'to stop, stand or park': its halt (drv.motion.complete_halt). 'for the purpose of loading or unloading freight' is a purpose, read through the halt it explains (observable_reading purpose)."}, {"span": "s5", "atoms": ["dev.zone_sign", "dev.governs", "rel.occupies", "st.travel_region", "prim.conditions_hold"], "derived": [], "justification": "'an accompanying sign' is a dev.zone_sign of kind parking_restricted ('a sign that begins or ends a signed zone along the road; ... conditions attribute: a structured reading of the sign's legend - a list of time windows ..., a duration limit, a vehicle class'). It governs (dev.governs) a travel region (st.travel_region) the subject occupies (rel.occupies): the lane beside the curb. 'in accordance with the conditions and times posted' is prim.conditions_hold ('the structured conditions of a device ... hold at the observation for a road user') for the subject. The dev.zone_sign contract does not state whether the condition holds now (its exclusion); the primitive does."}, {"span": "s6", "atoms": ["ru.aggregate=DEF-LVMC-11-02-140::taxicab"], "derived": ["drv.motion.complete_halt"], "justification": "Nearest atoms only; the span carries gap (s6). 'Taxicabs' is the admitted aggregate DEF-LVMC-11-02-140::taxicab ('a motor vehicle which is properly licensed under State and local law to provide taxicab service for a charge or fee'), one atom, never replaced by ru.taxicab. The run's reading includes no class under it (ru.taxicab is unresolved), so membership is never decided, which the gap states. 'to stop, stand, park': its halt (drv.motion.complete_halt). 'for the purpose of loading, unloading or waiting for passengers' is read through the halt it explains (observable_reading purpose)."}, {"span": "s7", "atoms": ["dev.zone_sign", "dev.governs", "rel.occupies", "st.travel_region", "prim.conditions_hold"], "derived": [], "justification": "Same words, same atoms as s5: a dev.zone_sign of kind parking_restricted governing (dev.governs) a travel region (st.travel_region) the subject occupies (rel.occupies), with prim.conditions_hold for the subject."}], "operationalizations": [], "assumptions": [], "intentions": [], "compositions": [], "residues": [], "binders": [{"name": "subject", "class_elements": ["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"]}], "applicability": "The subject is a vehicle (ru.aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle). At the judged observation, some region z of kind st.curb_zone whose colour is yellow has rel.occupies(subject, z). The duty does not apply under either exception. (1) The subject is a commercial vehicle (ru.aggregate DEF-LVMC-11-02-070::commercial_vehicle), and some dev.zone_sign d of kind parking_restricted governs (dev.governs) a travel region the subject occupies (rel.occupies), with prim.conditions_hold(d, subject). (2) The subject is a taxicab (ru.aggregate DEF-LVMC-11-02-140::taxicab), and such a sign's conditions hold for it. Each exception is a conjunction of the membership and the sign's conditions. Where the conditions are decided not to hold, the exception is false whatever the membership. Where they hold and membership is unknown under the run's reading, the exception is unknown.", "obligation": "The subject does not halt in z: not drv_motion_complete_halt(subject), with speed_tol p.halt_speed_tolerance, judged at the observations where the applicability holds, so the halt judged is a halt in the yellow zone.", "params": ["p.halt_speed_tolerance"], "narrowings": [{"span": "s2", "why": "The zones' establishment by sign, marking or paint is read through the presence of the signed or marked curb zone.", "kind": "observable_reading", "category": "status"}, {"span": "s3", "why": "'a zone for' commercial vehicles and taxicabs is read as barring the halt of any other vehicle in the yellow zone. It also bars their own halt where the accompanying sign's conditions do not hold. A halt outside the sign's hours is read as outside the conditions posted.", "kind": "reading"}, {"span": "s4", "why": "'for the purpose of loading or unloading freight' is read through the commercial vehicle's halt; whether freight moves is not read.", "kind": "observable_reading", "category": "purpose"}, {"span": "s5", "why": "The accompanying sign is read as a parking_restricted zone sign governing the lane beside the curb that the subject occupies. Its posting is the evidence of its force.", "kind": "observable_reading", "category": "status"}, {"span": "s6", "why": "'for the purpose of loading, unloading or waiting for passengers' is read through the taxicab's halt.", "kind": "observable_reading", "category": "purpose"}, {"span": "s7", "why": "The accompanying sign is read as a parking_restricted zone sign governing the lane beside the curb that the subject occupies.", "kind": "observable_reading", "category": "status"}], "scenarios": [{"name": "forbid", "expected": "violated", "narrative": "A curb zone z (st.curb_zone, colour yellow, kind freight_loading) has a zone sign d (dev.zone_sign kind parking_restricted, conditions: weekdays during business hours, class commercial motor vehicle) governing the parking lane beside it. A private passenger car (ru.motor_vehicle only) halts in z, at rest for several minutes on a weekday morning. The sign's conditions do not hold for it, so neither exception holds."}, {"name": "permit", "expected": "compliant", "narrative": "The same car drives along z without halting."}, {"name": "idle", "expected": "not_applicable", "narrative": "The same car halts for several minutes in a curb zone whose colour is white."}, {"name": "blind", "expected": "unknown", "narrative": "As in forbid, but the source supplies no speed for the subject (kin.speed absent), so whether it halts is unknown.", "masked": ["kin.speed"]}, {"name": "branch_1", "expected": "violated", "narrative": "A commercial delivery van (ru.motor_vehicle and ru.commercial_motor_vehicle) halts in z on a Sunday morning, outside the sign's time windows. The sign's conditions do not hold for it, so the commercial-vehicle exception is false whatever its membership."}, {"name": "branch_2", "expected": "violated", "narrative": "A taxicab (ru.motor_vehicle and ru.taxicab) halts in z on a weekday morning. The sign's vehicle class is commercial motor vehicle, so its conditions do not hold for the taxicab, and the taxicab exception is false whatever its membership."}], "literals": [], "param_proposals": [{"name": "p.halt_speed_tolerance", "unit": "m/s", "value": 0.1, "convention": "the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution", "source": "speed resolution of the acquisition standard's kinematic channel"}], "gaps": [{"span": "s4", "kind": "atom", "proposal": "`ru.business_vehicle` | a motor vehicle, or a motor vehicle with its trailer, in use for a business: identifiable by the business's name or livery on its body or by commercial registration plates, as the source records it **Not a stand-in for:** a vehicle over the jurisdiction's commercial mass class (`ru.commercial_motor_vehicle`) or a goods body (`ru.truck`) | local. It decides the road users the exception concerns: which vehicles may halt in a yellow zone to load or unload freight under the posted conditions. Today the run's reading includes no class under DEF-LVMC-11-02-070::commercial_vehicle ('maintained or used primarily for the furtherance of a commercial enterprise'), so membership is never decided and the exception's leaf is vacuous (gate VACUOUS, iteration 3).", "nearest": ["ru.commercial_motor_vehicle: 'vehicle over the jurisdiction's commercial mass class or marked as commercially licensed' — a mass class or licence is not use for a commercial enterprise, so the reading leaves it unresolved", "ru.truck: 'motor vehicle for carrying goods' — says nothing of the enterprise it serves", "ru.aggregate=DEF-LVMC-11-02-070::commercial_vehicle: admitted aggregate with no included class in the reading"]}, {"span": "s6", "kind": "atom", "proposal": "`ru.licensed_taxicab` | a taxicab displaying the licence under which it provides taxicab service for a fare (licence plate or number, roof sign and livery of a licensed operator), as the source records it **Not a stand-in for:** a passenger vehicle for hire without such licence display | local. It decides the road users the exception concerns: which vehicles may halt in a yellow zone to load, unload or wait for passengers. Today the run's reading includes no class under DEF-LVMC-11-02-140::taxicab ('properly licensed under State and local law to provide taxicab service'), ru.taxicab being unresolved, so membership is never decided (the same defect as G82). An operator decision that ru.taxicab's markings are the observable evidence of the licence (status), classifying ru.taxicab as included, closes it as well.", "nearest": ["ru.taxicab: 'passenger vehicle for hire, identifiable by its markings' — the reading leaves it unresolved under the licensing words", "ru.aggregate=DEF-LVMC-11-02-140::taxicab: admitted aggregate with no included class in the reading"]}], "gap_resolutions": []}

{"node_id": "LVMC_11_52_300", "law_refs": ["LVMC-11-52-300"], "subject": {"binder": "subject", "class_elements": ["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"]}, "segmentation": [{"id": "s1", "text": "Except for a motor vehicle,", "role": "exception"}, {"id": "s2", "text": "no person shall park", "role": "obligation"}, {"id": "s3", "text": "any vehicle", "role": "subject"}, {"id": "s4", "text": "on any street", "role": "condition"}, {"id": "s5", "text": "for a period of time longer than thirty minutes", "role": "condition"}, {"id": "s6", "text": "between the hours of one a.m. and six a.m. of any day.", "role": "condition"}], "elements": [{"span": "s1", "atoms": ["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-130::motor_vehicle"], "derived": [], "justification": "Nearest atoms only; the span carries gap (s1). 'motor vehicle' is admitted as DEF-NRS-484A-130::motor_vehicle ('every vehicle which is self-propelled but not operated upon rails'); ru.aggregate is 'membership of a legal aggregate'. The class atom ru.motor_vehicle never replaces an admitted aggregate. A trailer drawn by another vehicle is not 'self-propelled', so the definition's words leave it out; but the only class that carries a trailer, ru.trailer_or_combination, also carries the combination with its self-propelled towing vehicle, so the run's reading leaves it unresolved, and no vehicle is ever decided not to be a motor vehicle: the duty is never decided, which the gap states."}, {"span": "s2", "atoms": [], "derived": ["drv.motion.parked"], "justification": "'park' applies DEF-NRS-484A-155 'the standing of a vehicle, whether occupied or not, otherwise than temporarily for the purpose of and while actually engaged in loading or unloading'; drv.motion.parked denotes 'at rest at every observation of the window behind the observation, of length min_duration', a shorter halt 'is not denoted'.
